title: What If You Stood on Saturn's Moon Enceladus?

scenes.text: What if you stood on Enceladus? You'd weigh almost nothing, and the ground is spraying water.
Enceladus is only about five hundred kilometers wide. Its gravity is about one percent of Earth's.
On your first jump, a hop that lifts you half a meter on Earth would carry you roughly forty meters up.
The average temperature is about minus one hundred ninety-eight degrees Celsius.
Near the south pole, more than a hundred geysers shoot water vapor and ice into space.
Beneath an ice shell roughly thirty to forty kilometers thick, data point to a hidden ocean. You'd be standing on its roof.

description:
